conventions: Runs follow repo CLAUDE.md: copy the named fixture into each arm's run-local outputs/gtm-home, replace __RUN_DIR__ in copied state.json, git-init the copied context repo and commit every fixture file including dotfiles as 'fixture baseline', record matching before/after SHA-256 checksums for copied state.json, consume scripted replies in order, and save every complete user-facing message verbatim in transcript.md including working-position lines, previews, approval questions, and the final message. With-skill executors use gpt-5.6-luna; independent graders use gpt-5.6-terra. Baseline arms forbid every skill. Full definitions and criticality are in assertions.md.

evals.prompt: My GTM home is <run-dir>/outputs/gtm-home and Aster Grid is the active project at its root org. Define our first ideal-customer profile as `distribution-operators`. We are targeting Northern European electricity distribution operators with 100,000–1.5 million endpoints, internal field crews, at least three planning regions, and outage planning still coordinated in spreadsheets. Strong buying triggers are a regulator audit or an asset-management-system replacement. Transmission-only operators and utilities that outsource all field operations are disqualified. This comes from Mina's review of four won deals, so use medium confidence and flag the endpoint range for review after the next three opportunities. Keep the municipal-utility question open. Preview the complete proposed file before writing anything.
